messages:
alex: heads-up — ran the monthly access audit, and 3 folks still have billing-admin after we removed the GCP-billing group yesterday. seems like SCIM didn't drop those roles. any ideas?

maria: which users?

alex: sara@acme.com, dave@acme.com, and ops-bot@acme.com (service account). i checked console, group shows removed, but role still attached in rw-infra.

provisioner-bot: SCIM sync finished at 2026-02-10T11:02:45Z, delta=+0/-12 memberships, run_id=run_20260210_1102

tyler: hmm. sounds like a partial deprovision. there's a known race where manual role assignments (from legacy provisioning) override group removals during incremental syncs. do we have the group->role mapper config?

alex: i grabbed the mapper from the prod node. snippet:```json
{"mappings": [{"scim_group":"GCP-billing","grant":"billing-admin","priority":50}, {"scim_group":"GCP-billing-legacy","grant":"billing-admin","priority":40}]}
```

tyler: that priority ordering is fine, but the sync job uses batching and the deprovision path only checks group existence for the current batch window. if the user was removed between batch windows we won't clear the legacy manual grant. also, last week's service-account key rotation touched the provisioner KMS key — did that cause any decrypt errors?

maria: checked KMS logs, no decrypt failures 02/09-02/10 for key "scim-provisioner-key". cipher ops OK.

alex: where would the partial-deprovision show up in our logs? cloudtrail or internal provisioner logs?

tyler: provisioner logs: /var/log/scim/provisioner.log and we emit an audit event on role add/remove. search for "manual_role_assign" and "reconcile_skip" flags. example error we saw elsewhere:```
2026-01-12T08:19:33Z ERROR reconcile: reconcile_skip=true user=sara@acme.com reason="active manual grant present"
```

alex: ok running the reconcile preview: `/tools/scim_reconcile --scan --preview --filter=gcp-billing`

provisioner-bot: preview results: 3 pending removals found (sara@acme.com, dave@acme.com, ops-bot@acme.com). audit events not yet emitted.

sre-oncall: I'll run a canary reconcile at 15:05 UTC, watch for error spikes and audit webhook failures. :eyes:

alex: please run canary. if reconcile succeeds, we'll trigger full reconcile and close this. also opening follow-up ticket to add an integration test for the KMS permission and batch window race (#INC-4021).

provisioner-bot: reconcile started (canary) at 2026-02-10T15:05:12Z

provisioner-bot: reconcile finished at 2026-02-10T15:06:01Z — 3 removals executed, audit events emitted: [evt_8791, evt_8792, evt_8793]

alex: can confirm roles cleared for those 3. closing thread. will push fix to ensure reconcile treats manual grants as revocable when group removal detected (and add test). :white_check_mark:
